name: SemanticDependencyUpdater
author: Simon Heimler (gesinn.it GmbH & Co. KG)
Alexander Gesinn (gesinn.it GmbH & Co. KG)
Sebastian Schmid (gesinn.it GmbH & Co. KG)
Rcdeboer Remco C. de Boer
description: Monitors semantic data changes and updates dependent pages

SDUSettlePasses.description: Consecutive empty self-update passes that end an "Update Self" cycle (and let the waiting editor's browser reload). 2 is the safe default: a single empty pass can be a store write that is not visible yet (database replication, or a pass that still sees the state from before the save), and with 1 the cycle then ends before the page has its final values. 1 saves one re-parse per cycle (about 0.9 s on a small test page) but was seen to end a cycle too early in about 5 % of the saves in one measured setup (2 of 42, none of 27 with 2). Lower it only after measuring your own setup. Values below 1 count as 1.

SDUReloadPollIntervalMs.description: Milliseconds between two checks of the browser's reload prompt asking whether an "Update Self" cycle is done (action=sduselfupdatestatus, a cheap read-only request). Lower values shorten the delay between the server being done and the page reloading. Kept between 100 and 10000.

SDUIgnoredProperties.description: Property names whose changes alone must not trigger SDU. Defaults to SemanticExtraSpecialProperties' Revision ID property (___REVID), which - when enabled via $sespgEnabledPropertyList - changes on every single edit regardless of semantic content, verified empirically against a real installation. Harmless to keep if SemanticExtraSpecialProperties is not installed or ___REVID is not enabled.
